caption: The drawing features a single ornate gravy boat positioned centrally within a rectangular border. The gravy boat is rendered in shades of grey and black, suggesting it is a pencil or graphite drawing on a beige or off-white paper background. The vessel has an elongated, curving body with a spouted front and an upward-arching, scroll-shaped handle at the rear. The rim is decorated with a regular pattern of rounded bead-like elements. The gravy boat stands on three short legs, each with a ribbed texture at the foot and an attached decorative leaf motif on the upper portion. The shading on the body and legs gives the drawing a sense of dimensionality. The artist's signature, "M. FENIA," appears in the lower right corner inside the border.
title: Silver Sauce Boat
